entities.name: Codex Sinaiticus
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: One of the oldest and most complete manuscripts of the Christian Bible (c. 325–360 CE), containing the complete New Testament in Greek along with most of the Septuagint. Discovered at St. Catherine's Monastery on Mount Sinai. Now split between the British Library, Leipzig University, and other institutions.
